answer: An attacker therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The sable counter is kept in meadow and willow shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 709 identities would post 1799 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
